schoolName: American University of Barbados School of Medicine
reviewNotes: HOLD - AUB's official site describes a 5.5-year route for school-leaver entrants and a four-year MD route for eligible graduates, publishes a component-based USD fee schedule and English-language instruction. The Barbados Accreditation Council lists institutional accreditation through 2031, and CAAM-HP lists Accredited with Conditions for 2025-2027. Hold pending a scoped full-content packet that reconciles all tuition components, verifies clinical affiliation availability at application time, and assesses licensing eligibility for each target market without overstating it.
